scores.rationale: Unmarked drip-glaze pottery, no maker supported, glaze wear; low value as a mixed group.
Marked Carlton Ware Australian Design lobster salad set with servers, plate and dish; collected pattern, realistic total about $100-200.
Unmarked chemist ground-lid jars, decorator appeal, modest per-jar value, some loose lids.
Three new-with-tags Liberty cotton shirts, resale demand but used-market prices for shirts are modest, about $100-180 total.
1876 Tasmanian statistics in soiled wrappers has some Tasmaniana interest, rest is common books.
Unmarked Murano style pieces, one chipped, mixed with a Fenton style vase; likely $30-80 total.
Unattributed ruby bullicante bowl with aventurine foot plus a generic bowl; maker claim unsupported.
Wynns Michael 1994 and John Riddoch 1999 plus three decent reds; realistic total about $200-300 allowing for unknown storage.
Enamelled hock glasses and prunted roemers are decent but mixed with pressed glass; about $40-80.
Three framed Vanity Fair type lithographs, probably originals but unconfirmed; about $40-70 each framed.
